summary: I added three host-level mail tests to `crates/engine/aura-engine/src/agents/tests.rs`, and all of them pass. Test 1 runs through the existing mock turn, so I didn't need the `HostInner::deliver_message` fallback. That is the only file I changed, it is formatted with `rustfmt --edition 2021`, and nothing is committed.
